form-layout.$description: FormLayout: the gaps between fields and the look of groups.

caption-float.$description: Where a group's caption sits: none (on the group's frame) or inline-start (inside the group, above its fields).

field.$description: The form's fields: the width of their label column, where the labels stand beside the boxes (`labelMode: 'side'`).

group.$description: A group of fields under a caption: its card (a frame, a fill) and the room inside it.

caption.$description: A group's caption, on its frame or above its fields.
